summary.headline: Astrological Questions and Omens
summary.text: Astrological chapter list covering thieves and lost objects, runaways, active and inactive days and hours, months, airs, punishments, house collapses, conflagrations, migrations, fevers, contracts with women, absences from home, and return times. It cites Timaeus Praxides, Serapion, Theodore’s entry as Augustal prefect in Alexandria, and material edited in the appendix.
